summary: Friendly and clean: city names just work, and Boston at #11 and San Francisco at #13 are good near misses. A bit easy for classic; great as a Blitz.
reasons: Casual player finds all 10 by typing plain city names, losing lives on San Francisco (#13), Boston (#11) and Seattle (#15).
Phoenix beating Boston and SF is the one real surprise; otherwise the classic is close to all gimmes, so it suits Blitz better.
Blitz is deep: nearly any US city a player can name scores (29 of 30).
fixes: 'Bay Area' fuzzy-corrects to Santa Maria–Santa Barbara (#123) and scores it in Blitz. Add 'Bay Area', 'San Francisco Bay Area' and 'SF' as aliases of San Francisco–Oakland–Fremont (#13).
Add 'Twin Cities' as an alias of Minneapolis–St. Paul–Bloomington (#16).
#37 name keeps its suffix: 'Virginia Beach–Norfolk–Newport News, VA-NC, MSA' (and 'va-nc' matches it). Strip ', VA-NC, MSA' from the name and aliases.
Garbled aliases from word stripping: 'Salt City–Murray' (#46), 'Houston–Pasadena– Woodlands' (#5). Drop them.
Grand Rapids–Wyoming–Kentwood (#49) takes 'Wyoming' as an alias, so typing a state costs a life. Drop principal-city aliases that are also US state names.
